claim: MDS adapts the query summary at test time while keeping the pretrained neural posterior estimator fixed, preserving amortization.
quantifier: For both reproduced Gaussian and OUP mechanisms, every ordinary/MDS paired query must use an identical frozen NPE tensor state.
required_checks: NPE tensor SHA-256 is identical before and after adaptation
Gaussian and OUP use trained neural posterior estimators
at least 300 Gaussian and 250 OUP paired queries execute
the verifier exits nonzero on a hash or query-count mismatch
